title: Pool memory transformation
statement: For a natural number $N$ and an integer-addressed memory $m$ whose values are $W$-bit words, define the pool memory to be the result of applying the effects of the pool code for $N$ to the memory obtained by applying the effects of the head-straight code to $m$.
caveat: The definitions of the effects operation and the head-straight and pool codes are not included, so their precise mathematical meaning cannot be stated.
